meta_rows: Are you regularly taking any medicines or tablets prescribed by a doctor? - at age 43 years

This variable refers to derived regular medication data. This was asked at 1977, 1982, 1989, 1999, 2006-10, 2015 and 2023 data collection waves. Medication in the last 24 hours was only asked at the 2006-10 nurse schedule.  This question was also asked slightly differently in the 1999 data collection. Does not mention doctor in the question.
